Class Patient

java.lang.Object
usermain.User
usermain.Patient
public class Patient extends User
The Patient class represents a patient in the hospital management system. It provides functionalities to manage and view personal information, medical records, appointments, and treatment outcomes.

      public Patient(String patientID, String password, String role, String name, String dob, String gender, String contactNo, String email, String bloodType, String pastTreatment, AppointmentManager appointmentManager, DoctorAvailabilityManager availabilityManager)
      Constructs a new Patient object with the provided details.
      Parameters:
      patientID - The unique ID of the patient
      password - The patient's password
      role - The role of the user (e.g., "Patient")
      name - The name of the patient
      dob - The patient's date of birth
      gender - The gender of the patient
      contactNo - The contact number of the patient
      email - The email address of the patient
      bloodType - The blood type of the patient
      pastTreatment - Details of past treatments
      appointmentManager - The AppointmentManager instance for managing appointments
      availabilityManager - The DoctorAvailabilityManager instance for managing doctor availability
